recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add new Media-specific examples to current source/media; if additional clarification is needed, open a current-build DocumentReference/ImagingStudy issue rather than editing the removed Media artifact.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive OO issue FHIR-15088 asked for supporting use cases/examples to clarify the boundary between Media and ImagingStudy, including Media-as-Observation examples such as a cell-phone photo, blob-server images, and pathology-report images.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-15088. The old Media source already contained similar use-case and DICOM/WADO-RS boundary prose before the issue, and January 2018 OO WGM minutes record the boundary-clarification discussion that produced the Jira request.
additional_context: FHIR-23567 later merged Media into DocumentReference for R5 and moved Media examples into DocumentReference; FHIR-38950 explicitly copied Media boundary guidance into DocumentReference; FHIR-19250 added related DiagnosticReport/DocumentReference overlap guidance. In the current source, fhir.ini lists DocumentReference and ImagingStudy under [resources] but not Media, and history.html identifies Media as removed after R4B with DocumentReference or Observation as replacements.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active DocumentReference and ImagingStudy pages already explain audio/video/image representation, DiagnosticReport overlap, DICOM images through ImagingStudy or ImagingSelection, WADO-RS preference, rendered/portable images when full context is not important, and include DICOM ultrasound plus left-hand x-ray examples.
